hook.text: Lying awake at 3 AM? Try these 3 tricks. You'll be out cold in 5 minutes.
queries: woman lying bed eyes wide open dark bedroom
person checking phone time bed insomnia closeup
tired person tossing turning bed sheets night

tips.text: First, try the four-seven-eight breathing trick. Breathe in through your nose for four seconds. Hold for seven. Exhale slowly for eight. It calms your nervous system in minutes.
queries: person closing eyes deep breath bed slow
close up nose inhaling deeply peaceful
hands resting chest breathing meditation bed

tips.text: Next, cool your room to sixty-five degrees. Your body needs to drop in temperature to fall asleep. So crank up the fan or open a window.
queries: hand adjusting thermostat low temperature closeup
ceiling fan spinning bedroom dark slow motion
window opening cool night breeze curtains
person pulling cozy blanket up cold bedroom

tips.text: Last, the military sleep method. Relax your face. Drop your shoulders. Let your arms fall heavy. Slow your breathing. Most soldiers fall asleep in two minutes flat.
queries: person face relaxing pillow eyes closing
arms falling limp relaxed bedsheets closeup

cta.text: Save this for tonight. And follow for more sleep hacks that actually work.
